sentences.text: "Low on frozen mysis again — remind me to hit the wholesaler before Friday's route." Inside the van it smells permanently of brine, damp towels, and the vinyl gloves I buy in bulk. We recommend a bottom drain on anything over two thousand gallons; vacuuming a liner pond by hand gets old fast. Formal grading records list the breeder, spawn year, and certificate number; ours are filed in the office by variety. Honestly, the hardest part of this job is parallel parking a van full of sloshing water jugs downtown. "Did the yellow one die?" asked the accountant, and I explained the wrasse was just sleeping under the sand. Every Monday begins the same way: load the siphon hoses, check the test kit expiry dates, coffee, then the freeway. Next week I'll drain a third of the cichlid display at the credit union and finally rehome that bullying jewelfish. Twelve dollars a foot for the flexible PVC, and honestly, the rigid stuff fights you around every curve. Nobody warns you that a half-finished pond in July becomes a mosquito nursery by August. "Cut feeding to once a day when the water hits sixty," she told him, tapping the tub of wheat-germ pellets. "Your clownfish keeps spitting sand at the powerhead," the receptionist told me, delighted, before I'd even set down my bucket. By late October the yard smells of wet rubber and cedar shavings, and every pallet holds netting for leaf season. We chatted about his daughter's soccer season while the gravel vacuum churned and the water level dropped inch by inch. You learn to knock before wheeling the cart through a lobby at 7 a.m., because somebody is always mid-meeting behind the glass wall. Per the service agreement, filter media replacement at the Hartwell building occurs on the second Tuesday of each month. Why does every lobby aquarium end up positioned in direct afternoon sun? Meridian Dental's protein skimmer had overflowed onto the carpet, and the office manager greeted me holding a mop and a look. By the time she reached the insurance office, the algae on the back glass had thickened into green felt. Last spring we replaced eleven burst check valves for customers who skipped draining their external plumbing before the freeze. Did you measure the drop from your skimmer to the waterfall, or are we guessing on head height again? What is the meaning of the word tank?
